title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP04c — P2 trusted build isolation and workflow switch prerequisites
goal: Land every prerequisite for switching the required checks to the trusted base runner without changing any gate's judging entry point: place trusted guard build output outside head and base, fix the location-derived repository root in the LayerGuard policy binding tests, add CI activation contract checks that apply once jobs.json declares trusted execution, stop multi-script workflow steps from masking failing exit codes, prove that head MSBuild inheritance cannot reach trusted builds, and record D19 with the guarantee scope and break-glass procedure.
acceptanceCriteria: With GUARD_BUILD_ROOT set, Invoke-V3 and Invoke-IFX restore, build and test guard projects outside the target, the trusted base runner sets it inside its generation root, and a trusted-build-isolation check fails when guard build output appears in head.

LayerGuard policy binding tests read GUARD_TARGET_ROOT, set by Invoke-IFX during tests, and every runner mode including Architecture, Diff, Quality and Database passes against the repository from a base worktree.

Invoke-IFXCiContract rejects a missing base runner or gate ID, an in-place head dispatcher and a missing base worktree once jobs.json declares trustedBase execution active, and the declaration stays absent in this checkpoint.

Workflow steps run each guard or test script in its own pwsh process and fail on its exit code, v3-architecture runs Test-IFXTrustedBase -ArchitectureOnly, and the 13 required check names and judging entry points are unchanged.
D19, the authored trusted base guarantees and break-glass page, Plan 06 P2.2, P2.3, P2.5 and P2.9 evidence and the CP04c/CP04d split are recorded, and all guard tests pass.
